title: App shell: TanStack Start; the Barkpark token lives only in server functions

Browser bundle has no token code (build checked). A real turn ran end to end through the app on 2026-11-11 (T6).
gate: vite build fails if browser code imports server/barkpark (vite.config.ts); npm run turn:live (owner-run: needs the owner's Barkpark login and the enrolled Mac online; not in land or CI).
